title: Inter-rater reliability
subtitle: Obada and Kulsawasd coding independently, plus each coder against the automated rules

tables.name: irr_confusion_human_role
tables.caption: Confusion matrix for element role between the two human coders. Rows are Obada, columns are Kulsawasd.
tables.note: Off-diagonal cells are the items to adjudicate. A disagreement concentrated in one cell is an ambiguous rule worth rewording in the codebook; a scattered one is coder fatigue and is fixed by adjudication alone.

tables.name: irr_confusion_human_label_status
tables.caption: Confusion matrix for label status between the two human coders. Rows are Obada, columns are Kulsawasd.
tables.note: Off-diagonal cells are the items to adjudicate. A disagreement concentrated in one cell is an ambiguous rule worth rewording in the codebook; a scattered one is coder fatigue and is fixed by adjudication alone.

notes: Every disagreement is listed with its context in codebook_irr_disagreements.csv, with blank columns for the agreed code. Adjudicate them together, record the resolution there, and state in the Method section how many items were resolved by discussion.
Both coded variables met the pre-set inter-rater reliability target of 0.80.
limitations: Kappa is sensitive to the marginal distribution of categories. The sample is stratified by role and by automated label status precisely so that rare categories are represented; on an unstratified draw the same rules would yield a higher kappa with less information in it.
